title: Stage 5 identity role-history package v1
description: Complete identity role and signing-key change history for one environment/log, with a signed query-bound current head.
$comment: V1 accepts only complete-from-genesis-v1; filtered or checkpoint-only responses are not supported. query.challenge_nonce is generated by the verifier from 32 CSPRNG bytes and encoded as canonical unpadded base64url; the verifier accepts a nonce only for its one outstanding logical read. The query hash and signed head bind that nonce, preventing replay of a previous signed package for a new read. An exact retry uses the same nonce and query and returns the same snapshot; using the nonce with a changed query conflicts. The verifier never treats a replayed/expired nonce or stale response as fresh. The verifier checks every event source/scope, sequence, predecessor, record digest, and signature, starting at sequence 1 and the 64-zero genesis digest; empty history has sequence 0 and the genesis digest. The final event sequence/digest must equal history_head. The verifier recomputes query_sha256 = SHA-256(JCS(query)). The history-head signature covers JCS({schema,source_id,environment_id,log_id,query_sha256,sequence,record_sha256,observed_at_utc,signature_profile,signature_key_id}) using ed25519-jcs-identity-role-history-head-v1. The source identity/key status are independently pinned and observed_at_utc must meet the verifier-configured freshness TTL. Omission, reordering, filtering, stale head, invalid signature, or inability to return the entire log fails closed as unverified. JSON Schema checks shape only and cannot prove nonce entropy/uniqueness, completeness, linkage, signature, query hash, or freshness.
